segments.title: What built the first structure in space ALONE?
segments.say: What just built the first structure in space on its own? Astronauts, a robot, or a Mars rover? Comment your answer. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: A ROBOT!
segments.sub: Caltech's **ASTRA** robot, no human at the controls
segments.say: A robot! Caltech's ASTRA robot did it with no human at the controls.

segments.title: It built part of an ANTENNA
segments.sub: Talking to Earth only **15 minutes a day**
segments.say: It built part of an antenna frame in orbit, while talking to Earth only about fifteen minutes a day.

segments.title: A first, says Caltech
segments.say: The team calls it the first time a structure was built on its own in space.
Comment your answer, then follow for Guess It number 21 tomorrow.
